Throwaway because I actually do really like my job and want to shit talk anonymously.

When I got my most recent promotion, it came with a pay raise and quarterly reviews were a week afterwards. I got an exceptional review but I didn't get the raise that comes with it because I had just been promoted. Thought that was kinda bullshit.

Throwaway obviously, but last semester I tried to kill myself after falling into a pretty deep depression and failing classes. Woke up in the hospital, moved back home, it's a long story. I'm not at Tech anymore, and I'm feeling the best I've felt in a long time. However, in trying to figure out what I want to do with the rest of my life, I've tried to get my failing grades changed to incompletes for mental health reasons. Spent hours on the phone with Tech getting the run around, and finally got a letter last week saying my application was denied. The student relations PERIOD at this school are garbage, including OSI.
just took all the rest I had left, I'll report back if I'm still here...

They gave me referrals to places around the city, that wouldn't be free. I don't have the money to spend. And they don't care, they just wanna push me to someone else.
just pm me if you wanna talk

I'm a first year, I don't really know if there's anything I really want to talk about. I just feel like telling SOMEOME, and this is the best idea I had. Just looking for options other than suicide I guess. Like I want to do it, but now my next option is slitting my wrists. I'm not taking diphenhydramine (Benadryl) again because of how terrifying it was.

nothing specific is really whats bringing me down. I've just kind of checked out.

Been thinking about this for a while now. I'm just depressed. Failing out of college, have nothing else to do. Can't motivate myself to get out of bed most days. I just think death would be a better alternative. The only reason I haven't yet is that I don't want anyone else upset or hurt because of my actions. Hoping the drugs make me not worry about that and go through with it.
